1.2.0.title: Version 1.2.0 - What's New
highlights: Changed the calculation of weekly and monthly variances.
Weekly variances will now show only if Week 2 to Week 3 Variance exceeds the threshold.
Monthly variances will now show if any of the following exceeds the threshold: Month Month 2→3, Month 3→Current (MTD), or Month 2→Current (MTD)
Added a tooltip to those reports' Max Variance values, indicating which variance is shown.
Added a link in those reports to hide positive variances (since now many more sites will show).
